products.title: EGGspert Mechanic-Style Shirt
products.body_html: Tough, stylish and durable, with a generous fit across the chest and shoulders for easy movement while cooking. Embroidered patches call out your EGGspert status and the Established 1974 Big Green Egg brand. Lined 2-piece collar with permanent stays. 65% polyester/35% cotton permanent press poplin. Pocket divider to hold your pen or meat thermometer.

"Official EGGhead" on the front, "chicken, ribs, pizza, peppers, brisket, steak, prime rib, pork belly, corn on the cob, stir-fry, turkey, paella, ribeye, asparagus, smoke, bake, grill, roast, etc." on back.

products.title: Life Tastes Better Outside Olsen Hoodie
products.body_html:
Our “Life Tastes Better Outside” Hoodie in charcoal is soft, durable, and made for those cooler cooks. With our iconic wordmark on the front and our rally cry on the back, it’s basically your new favorite hoodie—with just enough room to layer underneath. Trust us: size up for that perfect relaxed fit. 
  
Why You’ll Love It: 
  • Soft, mid-weight fleece blend that feels broken-in from day one 
  • Recommended to size up for a relaxed, layered fit 
  • Ideal for early morning smokes, late night hangs, and everything in between

products.title: Life Tastes Better Outside T-shirt
products.body_html:
Some shirts just get it. Our “Life Tastes Better Outside” Tee in grey is made for the people who believe that time is better spent outside—with a grill going and nowhere else to be. Made from premium breathable cotton, it features the iconic Egg silhouette on the chest and our favorite four words on the back. Wear it anywhere, but preferably with smoke in the air. 
  
Why You’ll Love It: 
  • Soft, breathable feel and a shape that runs true-to-size  
  • Big Green Egg silhouette on the front, brand mantra on the back 
  • Built for backyard hangs, campsite breakfasts, and anything in between

products.title: Navy Wordmark T-Shirt
products.body_html:
Just like a low-and-slow cook, this tee doesn’t rush anything—and that’s exactly why it’s great. The Big Green Egg Relaxed Fit Tee in navy is soft, lived-in comfortable, and made to move with you, whether you’re tending the fire or just pretending you are. Featuring our iconic wordmark on the chest and oversized on the back, it’s subtle up front, party in the back. 
  
Why You’ll Love It: 
  • Relaxed fit for a more true-to-size feel 
  • Clean, classic wordmark design—front and (boldly) back 
  • Ideal for grilling, lounging, or both at once

products.title: Navy Life Tastes Better Outside with Mountains T-Shirt
products.body_html:
For the ones who feel more at home under the sky than a ceiling fan. This navy tee was made for slow coffee mornings on the patio, golden hour grilling, and any moment you’d rather be nowhere else but outside. Clean and simple Big Green Egg printed on the front, bold mountain-scape on the back, because even a shirt can daydream. 

 Why You’ll Love It: 

  • Soft, breathable fabric that quickly earns favorite status 

  • Big Green Egg on the chest, mountain graphic on the back 

  • Perfect for fire-side hangs, gear-loading Fridays, and wherever the Egg is lit

products.title: Atlanta Skyline T-shirt
products.body_html:
Like a love letter to the city that started it all, this tee celebrates 50 years of Big Green Egg history right from its Atlanta headquarters. The Big Green Egg Atlanta Skyline Tee in green is soft, lived-in comfortable, and made for wherever your day—or your grill—takes you. Featuring the iconic Egg shape overlooking the Atlanta skyline, it’s a subtle tribute to the birthplace, engineering, and perfection of the Egg—where it’s been designed, refined, and brought to life for the last five decades.

Why You’ll Love It:
• Relaxed, boxy fit for easygoing, all-day comfort
• Bold skyline graphic with the Egg front and center
• Perfect for grilling, lounging, or showing a little hometown pride for the city that’s been home to the Egg HQ for over 50 years

products.title: Retro Mountains T-shirt
products.body_html:
Like a sun-soaked road trip poster from the ’70s, this tee is all about chasing the horizon—and enjoying the ride. The Big Green Egg Vintage Mountains Tee in heathered tones is soft, lived-in comfortable, and made for wherever your adventures take you, whether that’s firing up the Egg in the backyard or escaping into the wild. Featuring a retro mountain scene and a bold nod to the greatness of being outside, it’s vintage vibes, modern comfort, all in one.

Why You’ll Love It:
• Classic, relaxed fit with a boxy silhouette for effortless style
• Retro ’70s-inspired graphic celebrating the outdoors
• Perfect for grilling, hiking, lounging, or just daydreaming about your next adventure

products.title: 2025 EGGtoberfest T-shirt
products.body_html:
Some shirts are just shirts. This one’s a collectible. Our EGGtoberfest 2025 “Life Tastes Better Outside” Tee celebrates the biggest Egghead gathering in the world. A once-a-year chance to eat, laugh, and grill shoulder-to-shoulder with the Big Green Egg community. With bold artwork on the back and an EGGtoberfest crest on the chest, it’s a wearable badge of honor for anyone who made it to hang by the fire.

Why You’ll Love It:
• A true collectible from the world’s largest Egghead gathering
• EGGtoberfest 2025 crest on the front, full “Life Tastes Better Outside” design on the back
• Soft, breathable cotton made to last long after the smoke clears

products.title: Silhoutte French Terry Hoodie
products.body_html:
Some hoodies are here for a season. This one’s here for the long haul. Our Big Green Egg French Terry Hoodie keeps it simple with the most recognizable logo in grilling. Made from premium 100% cotton French terry, it’s soft, durable, and ready for anything from backyard cooks to cool nights by the fire. Tonal drawstrings and a kangaroo pocket give it a clean finish, while the Egg on the chest quietly says it all.

Why You’ll Love It:
• 100% cotton French terry for comfort that wears in, not out
• Tonal drawstrings and classic kangaroo pocket for everyday function
• Features the iconic Big Green Egg silhouette—because some logos don’t need an explanation

products.title: Big Green Egg PE T-shirt
products.body_html:
Like a well-loved gym tee from back in the day, this shirt hits just right. The Big Green Egg PE Tee in heather grey is soft, lived-in comfortable, and made for all the moments that matter—firing up the Egg, hanging with friends, or just strolling through town with a little hometown pride. “Big Green Egg” arches across the top, “Atlanta” anchors the bottom, and a bold Egg silhouette takes center stage—classic, simple, unmistakably timeless.

Why You’ll Love It:
• Retro PE-style fit with a boxy, easygoing silhouette
• Green lettering on grey with a bold, centered Egg silhouette
• Perfect for grilling, lounging, or wearing a little piece of Atlanta history

products.title: Green Egg Silhouette T-shirt
products.body_html:
Just like a perfectly smoked brisket, this tee takes its time, and that’s exactly why it’s worth it. The Big Green Egg Silhouette Tee in green is soft, lived-in comfortable, and made to move with you, whether you’re firing up the Egg or just pretending you are. Featuring our center-stacked wordmark on the chest and a bold Egg silhouette on the back, it’s subtle up front, statement in the back.

Why You’ll Love It:
• Boxy, unisex fit for relaxed, easygoing style
• Clean, classic wordmark on the front and bold Egg silhouette on the back
• Perfect for grilling, lounging, or both at the same time
